The temperature-controlled swimming pool was an absolute delight in the crisp mountain air, perfectly maintained by Touseef and Tamzila, who ensured a relaxing oasis amid the chill.

The Khyber isn't just a hotel; it's an experience. We'll be back!

5/5 stars

reviews.title: Its a great location.... Some services leave a lot to be desired.....
reviews.text:
We were quite excited about our stay at the Khyber. Especially after everything we had heard about it. And it lived upto the expectations or atleast for the most parts it did.
The good:
1- Location location location --- this is one thing this hotel has going for itself. Its located in the lap of the snow capped mountains. You simpy can not beat the view. From our room (1021) it was unobstructed even sitting on the couch or from the bed --- straight mountain views. I hear room 1017 and 1014 have the best views
2- Saba and Khushbu who work at the restaurants are the sweetest. Absolute angels. So caring -- they really took great care of our old parents and our group overall. 
3- Spa - good spa - good service -- (wish they could take advantage of the views and design the spa room/windows accordingly)
4- Size of the rooms, Bathrooms are incredible. Fantastic.
5- Rashida and Imtiaz (?) in housekeeping were so sweet. 
6- the quality of linen and pillows is awesome. 
7- the musicial play Santoor and Rabad is awesome (perhaps lower the volume on the speaker).

What could be better:
a- Courtesy - I was VERY disappointed with the lack of courtesy from the reception staff and many of the guys at the restaurant. Maybe because we were coming from an amazing service at the ITC in Pehalgam and going to the Taj in Srinagar both with amazing service, the Khyber left a lot to be desired
b- Not to overgeneralize, but my friends who travelled with us had the same unaided view - The MEN that worked the front desk area and at the restaurants, coffeeshop just seemed to have an attitude about something. It was very weird. They would make eye contact but not acknowledge that you needed help. Things as simple as moving a couch so we could sit together as a group, started with a no, they would see you needed water but wouldnt bring it.  I'd highly suggest this crowd either go train at a Taj or let Saba and Khushbu lead this team - they can set the gold standard
c- The corridor can be noisy. We had a hard time sleeping just because how noisy the corridor was.  Maybe because our location was on the way to the pool.. but still....
d- Would love for the conceirge to be more knowledgable about the local surroundings. Especially about the outdoors and the local hikes etc. 
e- The hotel staff gets overwhlemed when large groups check in together. They have been around long enough that they should be able to manage these crowds well

Personally, if Taj or ITC were to open a hotel in Gulmarg with a similar view, I'd definitely stay there for their hospitality.

reviews.title: Luxury Amidst Nature - Outdoor activities could improve
reviews.text: Our recent 2-night stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa confirmed its reputation as the pinnacle of luxury in Kashmir. The resort boasts expansive rooms with breathtaking views, impeccable service, and a fantastic heated pool, all of which elevate the guest experience to extraordinary heights. However, while the resort excels in comfort and amenities, it falls short in integrating the natural allure of Gulmarg into its offerings. Visitors looking to engage in outdoor activities such as ATBs, skiing, or the Gondola ride will find themselves needing to arrange these externally, as the hotel does not provide these services. Despite this, the hospitality shown by staff members like Aijaz, Aamir, and Rayees in the restaurant was remarkable. Their professionalism and attentive service greatly enhanced our dining experiences and deserve special recognition. The Khyber is indeed a sanctuary of luxury, though a few more in-house outdoor services could make it truly unparalleled.

We talk of Gulmarg, we talk of Khyber. We clubbed it with Tulip season and a period which is in between seasons . which turned out pretty well as depending on the weather , which oscillates every hour , we had a taste of winter and summer both.
Glad the resort is centrally heated . 

Property - Excellent location ,stones throw from the Gondola and a kilometre from the market . Kudos to the architect for the beautifully planned and executed property .
Almost all rooms have a gorgeous view of the snow capped himalayas , and there are numerous exits at all levels  if you would want to venture out. open spaces could have been more .. though it may be a geographic limitation. There was snow all around at this time of the year, a photographer's delight . 

Rooms- Spacious, well lighted and heated . We got a south facing one, sunlight streamed in on a day or two. 

Food- Seven Star chef ...All meals have a very go od variety and superb preparation. Chicken Dosa in breakfast is a must.
Never miss the evening tea at Nauf, don't miss the Kahwa and Brownie . Wazwan is a must in dinner .Coffee is excellent, strong and hot . Alcohol is not served,but you can carry your own and sit in a well designed and luxurious space just next to the reception . smoking areas are designated. 

Activities- The heated pool is superb . well maintained,  plush interiors , huge glass windows , perfect water ,open 9 to 9, and attached with a Jacuzzi, steam and sauna- complimentary for guests . I was very happy with the maintainance. I didn't get a Chance to avail the Spa.Try trekking to nearby mountains,  it's very very scenic ,with multiple routes, but it's outsourced, so carefully negotiate the prices , inclusions and exclusions . local taxis are very pricey but negotiable. Gulmarg is full of ice related activities, so you can be as busy as you want to be . 

Staff- Very hospitable and polite  . Dominated by handsome young Kashmiri fellas with a smile ...Varun was one who was very very forthcoming and a sweet laden accent. 

Logistics - Check in and check out is smooth, baggage transfer streamlined  , good parking area , and you can almost ask for anything you need. Live instrumental music is notable and adds to the authentic feel . Room service is very quick . 

Caution- never leave property without a jacket and an umbrella.  Always negotiate with outsourced facilities. 

have a great holiday

reviews.title: A good Hotel
reviews.text:
The good things

(1) Lovely property done with beautiful interiors - Kashmiri artwork and pictures. 
(2) Rooms have similar rich finish with lot of wood on floors and walls and carpets.
(3) Central Heating
(4) Good food
(5) All staff are happy to serve you .
(6) Availability of agents outside the porch of the hotel who help you with the gondola rides , local trips and snow activities. Please note the activities mentioned in the website of the hotel like ATV rides are actually outsourced through these agents.
(7) The Himalayan view rooms offer a fantastic  view of the mountains.
(8) Proximity to the Gondola though I would advise visitors not to walk up the steep hill back to the hotel. The low oxygen levels and the cold could literally take the wind out of you. You can get a hotel cab to pick and drop you.

The area for improvement:

(1) I feel owing to lack of competition this property is a tad overpriced 

(2) Though the website mentions activities when we reach the hotel the staff wash their hands off citing it is outsourced. This is unlike Oberoi or Taj where their concierge takes responsibility to coordinate with the outsourced agents. Not a big issue but the customer trusts the Hotel and the Hotel taking no stake is uncomforting for the tourist

(3) Breakfast starts at 8 AM . We had a early flight and wanted breakfast at 7:30 AM. The live counters where not ready at that time and you had only minimal menu.  Most 5 star Hotels offers full breakfast earlier

reviews.author: Brijesh V
reviews.title: Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers
reviews.text:
Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers

We recently stayed at Khyber. We had booked 2 nights at Khyber. But since same category of room wasnt available on MMT. We had to book 2 different room categories for 2 nights. Upon arrival we were told by the check in person (who's name I dont wish to add here) that you guys will be fine and you dont need to change the room tomorrow. We were either ways fine- as we had booked different room category and we didn't care much about it. 

Next day morning we went for Gondola level 1 and 2. Must add location of Khyber is great. So we left early at 9 am after our breakfast. After a long and hectic morning at gondola we returned back to our room to find that our room keys wouldn't work. So we had to walk back to reception to be told by another arrogant staff that they have changed our room. This was shocking and disappointing at same time not because room was changed but because for the first time in history of all travel we have done in indis and abroad, we had a hotel staff who had moved our open luggage to another room including some very important medicines without informing us. Had they had informed is a night in advance that they had made an error and indeed we did need to move room. We would have just kept our stuff packed & would have happily moved. The real issue was managers arrogance / unapologetic behaviour. He was not only arrogant but also pressurised his staff to lie about the fact that the person had indeed informed us that we will not need to change the room.  
Anyways- long story short. Great location, great property. Ofcourse exhobitant rates for same. But do not expect service/ hospitality of a 5 star standards of the likes of Vivanta Dal Lake or ITC at Pahalgam. This is a great hotel with below average managers running it. 

Sir, Umar Tramboo (@utramboo). Request you to look into this mismanagement and make Khyber service great again

reviews.title: Superb resort but average food. No alcohol but BYO is fine
reviews.text:
I would agree with most reviewers here that the resort is truly amazing, and am not going to repeat what most have said about all the good things.
Instead, I will highlight some other things:

- The food isn't top notch.  Not what is expected from a 5 star resort this expensive. Also lacking local dishes.   Main restaurant Clove, where breakfast is also served, is very family oriented.  All tables are minimum 4 seaters, which was akward for me as a solo traveller, to occupy so much space when the place is busy and other guests are waiting for a table.  The breakfast itself again nowhere 5 star resort worthy, not enough variety, and the pastries/cakes were very dray on both my days.

-No alcohol served at the property.  But I knew this and came prepared :). At check-in they tell you it's totally fine to have your own liquor in your room or at the Hookah lounge in the evenings, where you can order your mixers and snacks as well.  This was one of my highlights.

-The massage at the Spa was a heaven and highly recommend.  Totally worth every penny.

Lastly, Mubashir at the Front Desk was a real superstar.

reviews.author: anonymous835
reviews.title: Lovely hotel and views but…..
reviews.text: This is a lovely hotel in a beautiful location.  Staff are friendly and helpful.  The Food and Beverage Manager and Chef worked very hard to look after me and I appreciated this very much.  That being said, when I checked in I was given a room that had two big problems - the view was of the car park and garbage-strewn slope.   I asked for another room and was told the hotel was fully booked.  So I unpacked and tried to rest.  The room was anything but soundproof.  There was so much noise I couldn’t rest and finally told the front desk that if they didn’t move me I would put a bad review on Trip Advisor.  They moved me to a room that had a lovey view and was very quiet.  They even admitted there was a problem with the soundproofing in my original room.  With the price of rooms at this hotel, I’m surprised that room isn’t heavily discounted.  It should be.  I appreciate the effort staff went through to fix the problem (and they did), the problem shouldn’t have happened in the first place.  Upon check out I attempted to use my Visa card and it was declined 3 times.  I paid the small outstanding account in cash (I was trying to preserve my supply of rupees which is why I wanted to use Visa).  When I got to my next hotel in Srinagar, staff charged 1 rupee to my card and it worked.  So clearly the Khyber hotel was trying to avoid the use of credit cards which is very tacky given the price of this hotel.  So all in all…a relatively nice experience but a few very unnecessary hassled (which seems to be common throughout Indian so-called 5-star hotels).  They charge international prices and often deliver very inconsistent and ordinary service.

reviews.author: IndiaTravelfreak
reviews.title: The Only paradise in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
If you have managed to finally get a booking for this hotel, consider yourself lucky especially in winters. The gorgeous views that you get of the snow and the mountains in winters from this hotel cannot be missed by staying somewhere else. 

Khyber has a touch of royalty in this vast resort uphill from the main and small Gulmarg. Highly secure and a friendly front staff and the resort staff, this resort gives us a complete luxurious experience from its amazing indoor heated swimming pool, to its magnificent pampering spa and its kahwah and bakery lounge. 

The rooms are spread across different wings and floors and becomes slightly challenging if you are at the end of the resort. Rooms are cosy but slightly dated and not much noise proof and so needs refurbishment at the earliest. Bathroms are good sized and best part is the always available hot water and heater in the rooms and bathrooms especially in winters. 

Food was great and buffet had a lot of variety in its spread daily. All the activities are in the vicinity from ATV and market and the Gondola is just 5 mins walk from the hotel to go up to the mountains. 

The only recommended place to stay in Gulmarg to add that zing to your vacation. Am back there again for sure.

reviews.author: Mr Wajid
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text:
Location - nestled amongst the gorgeous meadows of Gulmarg, 

Rooms - modern, well appointed with an attention to small details, done up in luscious dark wood. Spotlessly clean and good quality toiletries was the icing on the cake. The housekeeping was meticulous and ensured fresh linen, bedsheets etc for each day during our 5 day stay at the hotel.

Food - the food at khyber was one of the highlights of our stay. Whether it was the breakfast or the tandoori dishes at dinner, the food certainly exceeded our expectations.
While food was splendid, what made it better was the way the restaurant staff understood our taste preferences, would recommend dishes and even make things that were not on the menu on request.

reviews.title: Holiday in Paradise
reviews.text:
Four couples from Goa, including us, decided to take a trip to Gulmarg  after what has been a truly turbulent year for humanity. 
We were there in early April and serendipitously we were greeted by heavy snowfall.  Usually,  the snow starts to melt by April. This put us in a perfect vacay mood and we looked forward to a 'Chilled out' holiday! 
From the moment you enter the Resort,  you're transported into a different world.  The tastefully, exotic interiors put you in a wonderful mood . The view is just too fabulous from the resort. The Mighty Himalayas,  the Gulmarg valley and the Pine trees weave a magical atmosphere! 
We were in a Gulmarg facing room and I personally loved it.  Much ado is made about the Himalaya facing room , however the view from everywhere in the hotel is magnificent. 
They don't serve Alcohol but you can carry your own and sit in the Sheesha lounge in the evening and enjoy yourself. 
The food is quite nice , not excellent,  but the servers are always ready to please.  Firdaus, Feroze and Shaukat really took good care of us and made us very comfortable and welcome. 
The Mini Wazwan or Trami is like a Kashmiri Thali and has some Kashmiri specialities.  However,  I suggest you have this in Srinagar.  
The best thing about the resort was the Indoor heated pool overlooking the snowcapped mountains.  It was a surreal experience . 
The Gondola , ATV rides are all walking distance from the resort and you can really have the time of your life!

reviews.author: reena
reviews.title: Luxury Resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The impeccable colour combinations, minimalist aesthetics, and understated furnishings do not detract from the beauty of the place and makes it feel impeccably elegant and timeless. Besides the Kashmir style elements, the place has gilded ceilings and stunning wall artifacts, which are a feast for the eyes.

Blending the tradition of Kashmir heritage with contemporary sophistication, the palatial building of The Khyber Resort has a stylish ambience that creates an ultra-luxurious vibe. 

The spectacular lobby has an impressive reception desk, concierge and a sprawling multi cuisine restaurant that throws open the spectacular scenic view of the now capped mountains.

The lobby definitely makes a great first impression with its cozy interior and impeccable designing that is somewhat similar to the beauty of the paradise land. The staff is extremely friendly & helpful, and will go the extra mile to make your stay as memorable as possible. From the lobby, the plush carpeting takes you up to the luxury guestrooms and plush suites. 

Rooms 

The design in all rooms brilliantly combines contemporary style with local accents. The rooms at Khyber are spacious, luxuriously decorated, and most of them have wide balconies to take in the views.  

During our 2 night visit to the hotel, we stayed in a luxury balcony room, which overlooked the stunning picturesque beauty of the mountains.  It featured a magnificent carpeting, a large walk-in closet, a plush king bed, a wide sofa cum bed, tea and coffee sachets and flat-screen TV. 

The rooms are also really quiet and well insulated. The beds are spacious, and linens are of superior quality. There’s nothing quite like a luxury hotel that not only has great interiors, offers excellent service, and has crisp bed-linen you want to curl up in.

The marble bathroom had a wide mirror, sink, a separate rain shower and a deep-soaking bathtub.  One of the best things about hotel stays are soaking in a tub filled with warm water. The Bathrooms feature luxurious bath amenities.

The big windows with views offering a spectacular view of the mountains make you want to stay in the tub forever.

The Presidential suite @ The Khyber has contemporary furnishings that complement authentic silk wall coverings, chandeliers, wood paneling and ceilings painted in soft hues. Bedrooms are heavenly, temperature controlled and have all the luxury amenities. The suites are also equipped with kitchen, servant’s room and a balcony which offers a nice view of the mountains.

Since Khyber is a luxury and expensive resort, one can get some discounts by using coupons from online travel sites like Goibibo. 

Dining

Khyber has an exquisite multi-cuisine restaurant called Cloves that has authentic Kashmir cuisine and continental dishes that are served with warmth and hospitality. 

The Restaurant offers amazing views that you can soak in while dining. The best thing is that you can also order for room service in your own room as per your own convenience.

The hotel also has a popular lounge called Chaikash at the farthest end that serves the most quintessentially coffee, tea and kahwa. 

This place is one of the most desirable and enjoyable place in the hotel to sit and relax with a cup of hot coffee in your hands. The picturesque lounge opens up to an impressive view of the skyline with the majestic mountains in the background.

Calabash, their sheesha lounge, has fine carpets and seating, designed to invigorate lounging for hours on end and floor-length windows that look out to forests of fir and the Himalayas. This is indeed, a cosy nook, which gives you the much needed warmth after a chilly outing in the snow.

The chefs are diligent and ensure the freshest food is served with a touch of innovation. We specially loved the continental treats like the grilled fish, lobster and crab cakes.

I would highly recommend the salmon to be tried. Also not to missed are their delectable buffet spreads that speak in volumes about the enormous variety and freshness. 

The breakfast buffed spreads are the most amazing ones and comprise of fresh juices, detox shots, salads, yoghurts, dips, variants of breads along with continental breakfast like sausages, hams and eggs. The Southern delicacies include dosas, idlis, vadas and uttapams.

The Indoor heated pool and Gym

The Indoor heated pool, which is surrounded by a phenomenal 360 degree view of the snow capped mountains look amazing and make you feel relaxed while soaking in the warm water of the pool.  Heated to a comfortable temperature, you can take a leisurely dip or do laps to stay in shape. 

The gym is well equipped with the latest machines and helps you in exercising with the assistance of the in-house instructor. The steam, sauna and jacuzzi add to the pampering and should definitely be experienced. 

I had booked for a luxury Aromatherapy massage during my stay at their luxurious L’Occitane Spa. I decided to head down early and take a dip in the pool – which is an experience of being totally immersed in soft lights – and later relax in the Jacuzzi followed by steam and sauna.

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling - AGAIN
reviews.text:
Stayed with family during the week of Holi for 5 nights for a ski holiday.
Visited last year during the same time as well.
Nothing has changed from our last visit.
Getting to and fro to the hotel is a nightmare! After a long day of skiing this is extremely stressful.
The ski storage room has been made much smaller than the previous year.
Service still seems to be very hit and miss.
i doubt if the food served at the buffet is freshly made. the fruits on display at the buffet looks very good but one bite and you know its just frozen fruit which is being served again. Similarly, most of the food just didnt taste right. Maybe it must have been frozen and de-frozen on a number of occasions. Our two kids and myself threw up one evening on the dinner table. 3 days after eating the buffet we decided to order from the menu and paid the high rates. we requested them to prepare the meals fresh and finally we got something decent to eat.
The reason for our repeat visit is that there is no other hotel in Gulmarg with so much space. it is a beautiful set-up.
Unless the oberoi comes up soon.. we have no option but to visit this place for our annual ski trip. the owners are aware of this.
The normal routine revert will be given by the manager once this is posted asking me why i did not bring up these topics during my stay.
Sir, getting to and fro to the hotel - spoke to so many people about this. Front Desk, lobby manager and also to the people who wear long black coats and suited and are always hanging around near the reception area. None of them could give any answer.
With regards to the food - Time and again spoke to the person who manages the buffet.. The only response we got was that the food is freshly prepared and that they are sorry that we did not like the buffet spread or it was not upto our expectations. Finally, we ordered a-la carte and pai for the meals.
We also brought up the topic of hearing of TV from the next room. This happened last year and this year as well. We were politely told that they cannot change the structure of the rooms.
The hotel was at 35% occupancy utmost, but they kept mentioning that they are sold out whenever we requested for a change of rooms.
Owners, please improve your service before its too late. i hear the Oberoi will be functional in a years time!

reviews.author: Vrinda G
reviews.title: It's a tourist trap. Avoid
reviews.text:
Value for money - not worth Rs 23,000 per night. This is what I paid in April 2017. This is a 5 star hotel but they do not operate by the ethos of a 5 star property. It would be better stay at a 2-3 star hotel and not expect any service than staying here and paying more than 5x and still not having your expectations met. The hotel operates 'by its rule book' which has no mention of giving a 'wow experience' and therefore the hotel staff is totally unaware of it. For everything else they will point to their website or other sources for not accommodating you.

Food - Most of it is pre-cooked stuff that they source from outside. So they can't customize a lot of things. A 5 star usually gets everything made in house. Second, I asked for a Kashmiri dish to be served in my room. They refused to do so because it was not in their in-room menu. Other 5 star hotels would routinely do this for you. However they did serve me a masala chai free of charge on the last morning. Thank u for that. 

Alcohol - only 1 hotel serves alcohol in gulmarg. The hotel did not inform me. I spoke to a person (Irshad Ahmad and his colleague Rasheed) to find out about setting up a private dinner for us few days before traveling to Kashmir. We spoke about wine etc, but he didn't mention this even once. Upon reaching when I found out that this hotel doesn't sell alcohol, I asked him that why didn't he inform me about this? His reply was that it's written on our website. I haven't been able to locate where on the website do they mention this. 

Customer service - at the time of check out, they pointed out that one of the towels has henna stains. I put herbal henna in my hair, which sometimes leaves stains. These stains are 100% removable. They charged me extra 1500 rupees for that towel. I paid it but my problem with this behavior is when they charge Rs 23,000 a night, wouldn't such wear and tear be built into their rates? Do they charge other guests when some one drops a glass or a plate? It's just as simple as looking for an opportunity to fleece another Rs 1500. I have stayed at many 5 star properties but no one ever in my life has done this. 

Mr Abhishek (the manager) hung up on me when I told him this. I accept that I was agitated with this entire episode. But hanging up on a customer shows that they don't care about what you have to say. The hotel is doing well and they don't need repeat customers. I wouldn't be surprised to see a defensive response to this review telling me how they did everything right and I was an over demanding customer.

I paid close Rs 100,000 for 3 days including food etc at this hotel. I deserved better treatment.

reviews.author: Umnada
reviews.title: Fantastic setting, great hotel
reviews.text:
This is one of the nicest hotels I ve been in and believe me I ve been in quite a lot of this type of hotels.
From the moment we arrived we were treated like maharajas. The manager and his staff came to greet us and welcome us. We were served with warm Kashmiri tea and ushered to our room, where someone came with us to check us in.
The room was very spacious and beautifully furnished in Kashmiri style. Bathroom is a little small but practical. The view from our window was like a picture postcard. I ve posted it below.
Amenities are excellent
Staff are very helpful and friendly and the waiters want to feed you more during mealtimes.
Breakfast is very basic , mostly indian cuisine which we were not familiar with, but we got one of the waiters to bring us something and it was worth trying it. Different but nice. Don't miss trying out the indian breakfast is quite different from the western style breakfast . Otherwise the usual international stuff of cereals and eggs with toast is available .
Dinner is almost similar to breakfast, a lot of indian cuisine. For the first night We had to order al carte for Kashmiri food which was nt being served on the buffet . I guess cuz most of their customers are Indians and so they cater for them mainly .
Their spa is very basic , but the masseur is very very good. I recommend a body massage after all the days activities on the snow.........
Don't miss out on the gondola ride which takes you up to 14,000 ft above sea level. We hired Wellington boots and a heavy snow coat which we really needed as it snowed quite heavily while we were up there. 
We only went up to 10,000 ft and enjoyed the rides. The snow  sledge ride pulled by men instead of dogs is fun , and the snow bike is exhilarating .
Be careful with the vendors there, they ll try and get as much as they can out of you, so bargaining is the word of the day .
I m sure you ll enjoy this trip and particularly this hotel as much as we did
Have fun

reviews.author: Nishant Agrawal
reviews.title: Amazing Stay

Had an amazing stay at the Khyber.

Nice cozy rooms with all amenities
Good food - unexpectedly the food including the breakfast was pretty good. Try the a la carte (buffet is pricey)
