We clarified that nothing like that and its unfortunate that we will not stay for 2 night. As per policy they couldn't refund for night which we didn't stay but made our lunch, dinner and internet free. Nice to see that atleast Hotel cares for their guest and willing to take that extra step to give comfort to their guests. Done relaxing SPA and is highly recommended.
Room we got was nice spacious room. Hotel is offering 4 start facility and very popular. 
However this come at very high price tag. Need to pay INR 200 for 30 min next access.
Breakfast opens at 8.00am which is bit late, sp when tourist rush for Gondola tkt in early morning.
Overall very satisfied and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Yogesh C
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
It's a amazing place to enjoy. Though gulmarg itself is fabulous but except gandola ride there is not much to do. So if you plan to stay in gulmarg for more than 2 days for its weather and snow mountains then it's necessary to have a good hotel. Khyber is a amazing place to enjoy with family. More or less all rooms have mountain view. There is not much difference in premium rooms and luxury rooms besides the balcony in luxury room but it's very cold to sit outside. Even the chaiska tea parlour has a outside sitting. Location of resort is very good it's hardly 5 mins walking from gandola. So no need for taxi in gulmarg if you are staying here. The spa of the resort is also good with lot to offer, spa rates range from 4500 for 60 mins to 10000.
The most amazing thing I liked is the swimming pool. In such cold weather the water and surrounding temp is well controlled. Me and my 5 year old sone enjoyed a lot in the pool. 
Except spa all other activities are complimentary. Though the children gaming zone igloo was not working. Food quality is good. If you can get package inclusive of food it's good as you won't go out for food mainly for dinner. Buffet is around 2000/- per person. Buffet has a good spread with starters also.

We stayed for 2 nights and we enjoyed a lot. I'll surely recommend it.

reviews.author: SanjaySurana
reviews.title: Just Superb!
reviews.text: Stayed at this resort for 3 nights as part of a marriage group. Location of Khyber and views from the hotel were absolutely wonderful.  Hotel is mostly wooden and is beautiful. Rooms are spacious and well done. Staff and service were up to the mark. Khyber has a heated swimming poo with great view  and their Jacuzzi is wonderful. I really enjoyed their Kashmiri Kahwa and massala tea. . Only problem I could see was the navigation from rooms to banquets and other places was a little confusing especially because there were no proper directions laid out. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: kagarwall
reviews.title: Stunning property !
reviews.text: Breath taking property ! Fantastic ! The hotel is really beautiful. It was amazing swimming in the heated pool in a glass house with snow outside. The view is also amazing. The rooms are also very nice. BUT very expensive. The food is excellent but also VERY EXPENSIVE. NO FREE WIFI even in the lobby. Service is very good but not excellent.

reviews.author: jitendram2014
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service is Mediocre
reviews.text:
We stayed for a Night at Khyber after hearing very good things about the place. The Hotel is located at one of the best spots offering beautiful view of Mountain clad with snow, There is snow in the property also
Service: Very mediocre considering the overall offering, Five star positioning and the cost. 
Cost: The cost is very high for the services. The Menu is heavily overpriced.
Location: Beautiful. 
Food Options: Good options for food. There are interesting options like a dedicated Cigar Bar and a Chai Bar.

A better service and a fair pricing would definitely move it a notch up

reviews.author: RSB54
reviews.title: Super Resort and beautiful location
reviews.text:
It lives up to its reputation of being an excellent property ! The staff is also very courteous and helpful. Its professionally managed and we had a very good experience.
There was a minor issue of leakage in the bathroom which was efficiently sorted out.

reviews.author: Shweta M
reviews.title: Pricey but no option
reviews.text:
A lot of the glitter of Gulmarg rubs off on The Khyber, and even though you've paid a bomb and received sub-par service (especially for those used to Taj standards), you come back feeling - Where else, in this snowy wonderland.

First a disclaimer - mountains are difficult to live in, basic amenities like water and hot food are difficult to come by, so giving 5 star amenities & service is commendable.

The Non-so-great parts : The grounds are not very expansive, there is a small courtyard and the rooms on the outside look onto the wired fence - not a bad view when everything is covered in snow. The food is decent but no authentic Kashmiri flavours in the breakfast or dinner spreads. There is a kids' play area but it's not well stocked and either are there any caretakers arounds. The corridors get drafts of cold air so be careful while walking down from the spa or pool. 

The Bad - the service is slow and patchy. 

The Awesome - The heated pool and spa area is amazing. A great way to relax sore muscles post skiing or playing in the snow. The glassed pool looks onto the snow & is almost magical. The lobby has little niches with a Kashmiri touch - carpets, carvings etc which are lovely and great for kids to be contained.

The Practical - The Khyber doesn't serve alcohol, but allows you to carry your own in their hookah bar, so do stock up in Srinagar.

reviews.author: abs34
reviews.title: True 5 * resort
reviews.text: Had visited as part of company Conference on 2014  August , Truly found a Royal Resort with excellent view . Only Downside  was the food which is letting down the resort  but overall a Royal resort . Would visit again

reviews.author: dsbhatt
reviews.title: Holiday 2016
reviews.text:
Fantastic property,had a great time.

Courteous staff and well maintained...

The spa is definitely worth trying and the food too is well prepared.....

The view too from their rooms is awesome.A must visit property

reviews.author: Ajay J
reviews.title: Exceptional location and exceptional hospitality
reviews.text:
I am a world traveler and Khyber is one of the best locations I have stayed so far. The location is exceptional, the hospitality is par excellence. The GM Mr. Sujith Herbert is a committed Hotelier and under his guidance the entire team of Khyber works very hard to make the guests stay comfortable.

The huge lobby area is comfortable and warm and furnished in style. The snow clad view of Mountains from the Lobby is stunning.

The staff is very friendly and smiling. 

The rooms are very comfortable, specially the size of the Balcony is very large and the views outside are just perfect.

The Wi Fi worked perfect in every corner of the Hotel.

If one is in Gulmarg, One should be in Khyber.

Best Wishes. Ajay Joshi

reviews.author: Reviews-by-MT
reviews.title: Nice hotel but Sadly did not enjoy Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at the hotel. It is actually one of the best hotels in the region. We enjoyed the warm welcome drink of Kawah in the cold weather. The Kawah is made up safron and almonds with cardamon and makes it a refreshing warm drink. 

We were allocated a room on 1st floor with a side view of the snow caped mountains. It was OK room. We were ugraded the room to a better room the next day . one of the drawbacks of the hotel was the actual contruction and layout . There are no lifts and the stair case and the coridors are very badly lit. 

The restaurant was OK and the food was not bad. The staff did actually see through to our special diet and needs. 

They have a nice indoor swiming pool with see through glassed walls where you can enjoy a good scenery whilst swimming. There pool is not managed too well. The local guests do actually behave so badly and are notoriously loud without giving any consideration the other guests. Sadly the Jacuzi and Sauna were out of use and were being renovated at that time.  

The Management of the hotel could however be improved. There was no proper guidance or information from the hotel about the sight seeing or about the operation of Gondolas and Guides . The hotel should organise the tours and tickets to the Gondalas and provide the excursion or at least have a fixed price policy controlling the touts /local guides who are such a menace, just there to loot you. 

We were set to go to the mountains on the Gondolas and a short ride of 500 metres from the hotel to the Gondola base cost us 500 rupees and the guide charged us 1200 rupees just to be with on teh Gondola . It was really not worth the trip to Gulmarg. The people of Gulmarg all appeared notorious and untrustworthy - just there to loot you. There is no management whatsoever by the Government . The place is litered despite the natural beautiful surrounding . 

The Gondola Management is also the worst one could expect. No system at all and there is no consideration given to the weak , old or people with small kids. Absolute chaos. 

When on the hills, the sledge touts are after you and are very forceful. Serious accidents can happen as the snow is turned into ice and is very slippery . We saw old people fall and yet there were many who were extremely cold and just wanted to get down the hills but yet could not get onto the gondolas because of the unmanaged crowds. 

Being the best hotel in the area , the managment should at least see to their guest comfortable stay.  The hotel is undoubtedly over hyped and over rated and the rates are unreasonably high. 

Despite the natural beauty of Gulmarg, I would not return back , firstly due to the people there and secondly because it is not maintained  and managed properly.

reviews.author: Pri S
reviews.title: The best of all
reviews.text:
This is one of the best hotels that I have come so far. Situated in the picturesque Gulmarg where the snow clad mountains and terrains make the place a fairyland, the resort matches international standards. The staff are warm and courteous and take care of the guests. The rooms are spacious overlooking the beautiful slopes of Gulmarg. The lobby is grand and has enough seating space to enjoy a relaxed evening. Though I did not use the spa and the swimming pool but did visit them and they looked like to be worth a try. I will surely go back and stay here in future. The food in terms of variety and taste however can improve a little bit
I was on a business trip for a meeting.

reviews.author: Anurup M
reviews.title: Great Property, Bad Service!
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful! The huge lobby welcomes you in, and the view of the Himalayan mountains and forests is awe inspiring. We sat down for some tea at the lobby cafe. Unfortunately, the service was a disappointment. The staff was unfriendly, unhelpful and in general just not very pleasant. For a resort this expensive, I would like to be treated well. I was hoping to return with my entire extended family for a big vacation. I changed my mind after my first visit, only because of the staff. Else, the resort truly is beautiful.

reviews.author: SherryMerchant
reviews.title: Nice hotel poor service
reviews.text:
Lovely location and views from the room, lovely rooms. Large and comfortable. Staff generally very nice and try to please but we found the service a bit sloppy: first night we reached the restaurant just before the last order time and by the time we were shown the table and given menus it was 4 minutes past. We were told the cook had left. Later we discovered that two staff wanted to leave so we were asked to eat the buffet I stared at a discount. After making some noise, we them were served dinner but a bit of a sour taste. Next day at breakfast we were refused brown toast because it was over. In a top class hotel? After noise was provided to us. This was random few staff, others generally good. Other thing is that in the room they are miserly with tea and sugar and mild, also I could not understand having cups and no saucers in the room.
The cost of two regular rooms gets you a two bedroom villa that has an extra maids room and kitchenette and extra loo, so actually five people can sleep comfortably. Just a tip.
On the down side, passages are chilly, not heated so that's not very comfortable. Service not as good as you expect for that kind of hotel. No free wifi at such a high room rate is unacceptable.

reviews.author: Prereeka S
reviews.title: Best property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: This hotel has the best view of the mountains. Has a proper Kashmiri decor and interior. View from room is spectacular. Service is good and the staff is also well managed. It's the best property in Gulmarg. Good service and view. As good as a five star!! Must visit. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: vikramsaraf
reviews.title: Heartwarming Experience
reviews.text: Had an awesome stay at Khyber for 2 nights. Incredible location, facilities and sumptuous food. Special thanks to the GM, Mr. Sujith for personally taking care of my son as his feet had become numb after playing in the snow. Would strongly recommend this to anyone visiting Gulmarg. 3 cheers to Khyber!

reviews.author: RadhikaAC
reviews.title: Great stay with amazing views
reviews.text:
Best time would be from Nov-March when it is snowing. The views are amazing. 
It was a family trip with grandparents, parents, children.

ROOMS 
take the rooms with the balconies, has amazing views.  

FOOD 
There is only 1 restaurant but the food is very nice. 
Definitely include breakfast - there is a live dosa/ uttampam counter, live eggs, and a great spread. enough to keep you full till evening snacks. 

There was a dinner buffet as well, but since we don't have big appetites & we were with grandparents & children we ordered  a la carte- we tried the italian chinese & indian. 

They have a seesha lounge too - where you get seesha & starters. They do not serve alcohol so Don't forget to carry your own alcohol & you are allowed to have it in the seesha lounge. 

Coffee shop (forgot the name): Amazing kahawa (local kashmiri tea) & a nice place to enjoy the view & have evening snacks. 

POOL & SPA 
The L'occtaine spa is really nice. Pool has amazing views & is temperature controlled. the changing rooms have nice steam, saunas & a good jacuzzi too. 

TRAVEL 
There is a taxi union in gulmarg, so you have to use those taxis only. 
Khyber is very close to the gondola ride as well, you can actually walk it up. 

2-3 nights would be an appropriate stay if you are going in a group.

reviews.author: Rajiv M
reviews.title: Less than advertised
reviews.text: It's the best hotel in the area. However, not close to a 5 star. The food is average. The service tries but needs more training. The spa is good but it is too far from the rooms.  The buildings are drafty and the room gets cold. I'm not likely to come back.

reviews.author: panks_41086
reviews.title: snowy resort
reviews.text: This the best resort in Gulmarg. We stayed there for 3 nights during winter. When we reached there was snow fall going on so It was fully covered with fresh snow & looking very beautiful. Very good ambiance with very good feeling. Staff was very courteous & helpful. Rooms were also good & spacious. Food was also good. Specially the Kehwa served here was very good.

reviews.author: Trisha C
reviews.title: Perfect holiday
reviews.text:
Superb property nestled in the gorgeous valley of Kashmir. Every thing is perfect. Perfect for families n friends for 4-5 days. Blissful 
The breakfast buffet is very satisfying. Lunch n dinner buffets have a nice spread and yummy food. The rooms are spacious. For family, would recommend taking the villa/appt. 
the skiing is very close by. Hotel takes good care. Even the 2 hour drive from the Srinagar airport to Gulmarg is beautiful and scenic. 
It's a paradise so close to home.

reviews.author: crazymanmeet
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text:
My family (Three of us in Srinagar) had an awesome trip. 
We loved the Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg - no hotels could have been more beautiful or welcoming. It seemed specially attuned to nature and contemplation. We just wanted to be there longer. We felt like visiting royalty every step of the way.

reviews.author: ssamra
reviews.title: Something is missing
reviews.text: Khyber is the best option in beautiful Gulmarg. Even towards end of April Gulmarg was all covered in snow. Hotel location is excellent and very near to Gondola boarding point. Staff is very good and so is food, spa and all other hotel facilities. But something seems to be missing to rate this property excellent. When I compare  it with Oberoi's hospitality at Wildflower Hall or Cecil Shimla or with the newly opened JW Marriott at Mussoorie, I definitely feel something is missing for the price I paid. But I am well compensated with the beauty of Gulmarg. Gondola ride to  Apharwat  is not to be missed. If you afford Khyber is the only choice to stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: JainKavyah
reviews.title: ONE IN A MILLION!!!!
reviews.text: Visited khyber in this april with my family. It is d most beautifull property in gulmarg. The food was xcellent..the breakfast buffet was one of its kind. The most important thing in any hotel are d staff.... N the staff here are simlpy beyond comparison.. Not just one but all of them!!!  Hats off to  mr. Umar tramboo who has put kashmir hospitality back to its best. My one destination for an ideal holiday will definately be "khyber"... An advise to my trip advisor friends, if u r in gulmarg then dont miss khyber....its one in a million!!!

reviews.author: postkunal@gmail.com
reviews.title: Snowy Paradise .....!!!!!!
reviews.text:
Been to Khyber Gulmarg for a Business Convention Meet for Four days during 2nd Week of April 2015. It was a two and half hour drive from Srinagar into the snowy town of Gulmarg. The Resort is just perfect.....lovely wooden ambience takes you to the colonial era ...I have been to scandenavian countries of europe but must admit it was no less. The pictureasque place of Gulamrg adds beauty to the resort as well. 

Location is superb . Food was also nice catering to vegetarians like me.....It was truly a fabulous property to spend a luxurious vacation.

Couple of observations : -

Found it really hard to locate the Tea Maker Kit in the room as it was hidden into a unique drawer. 
Room Heating was not available in rooms.
Complimentary Drop facility to lowland/gondola could be contemplated by resort.

Staff and hospitality levels were exceptional  at the resort...Wish to take my family along next time when I visit gulmarg.

reviews.title: Fantastic on all counts
reviews.text:
More than a 5 star. Excellent location and great view from all the rooms. Excellent food and a massive buffet spread. Staff was kind helpful and most attentive to every minute detail. 
Had a fantastic 3N stay

reviews.author: Yashwant Jhabakh
reviews.title: Holiday with some friends
reviews.text: What a super place ...... Heaven on earth... loved every part of the hotel .   The indoor swimming pool is just super ... lovely Cieling height and large glass windows .... simply divine.... would love to come to this place again and spend a week skying.

reviews.author: RekhaThaker
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: We visited in April this year and the resort was covered in snow to our surprise. Most beautiful place this is. The food is also very nice. The buffet laid for breakfast and dinner is excellent. The service provided at the restaurant is great. Mr. Sajjad Lone really took care of us at the restaurant. The rooms to select should be himalayan view. We used the spa facility but were not very pleased. The heated indoor pool is great. My husband had a fall and the in house doctor  Nazir was of great help. Too good a place and given a chance I can go again and again. The draw back is no free internet. They charge you for it and that is not right after the rates what they charge you for the rooms.

reviews.author: Sunayna Pateria
reviews.title: Birthday celebrations in the snow!
reviews.text:
I went for my birthday in April to Gulmarg this year and it was absolutely fantastic.

Khyber hotel offers the best indoor heated swimming pool which was the highlight of the hotel. My husband and I did the couples retreat in the Spa by L'occitane which was very good as well. They also have swimming costumes on sale which came very handy.

Their Sheesha lounge had very good sheesha which I personally was very happy about.  The food however in their restaraunt is super average. I would recommend to try other hotels which we did not have the liberty to do as we were short of time. Highland Park seems to be high on everybody's list.

They donot serve any alcohol but have all the crockery necessary which was a plus as well. Overall the service was great even though it was a bit slow. The view from the hotel is unimaginably beautiful.

reviews.author: YusuF P
reviews.title: Best of everything
reviews.text:
The hotel service and rooms are both excellent. the best part about it is that it is situated closely to the Gondola ride, which is a walking distance from the property.

amazing amenities, excellent rooms and all with such fantastic view. we were lucky to have snow at the time of our stay, which just romanticized the entire holiday. 

Lovely food and excellent service with a special care towards children.

reviews.author: Rajesh S
reviews.title: Excellent property at heavenly location
reviews.text: The Khyber is great property at Gulmarg.  You can see the picturesque views of fully covered white hilltops from almost all locations of Hotel, like restaurant area, lobby, room balcony. All the staffers behaves nicely.

reviews.author: DheerajRathi
reviews.title: The best I have been to
reviews.text: This is the best hotel I have been to. The interiors, facilities, swimming pool are awesome. Service and food is great. Don't miss this place. Only minus no free wifi. It is one of the most special swimming pools you will swim in

reviews.author: MeenalmumMumbai
reviews.title: A modern oasis of luxury in snowed out Gulmarg, with great service...
reviews.text:
Firstly, one is awed when one walks into the large lobby in a place like Gulmarg. Clearly it is a comfortable, luxurious hotel in a small town which has otherwise quaint hotels. We stayed there when the flood news was at its peak and it was a luxury to drive up to the lobby in the car in five feet plus snow. Most definitely the service is great with all requests and questions immediately attended to. I would like to specifically congratulate the hotel for the following two challenges we faced. Firstly, my 13 year old son fell very sick and the house doctor was very responsive and genuinely concerned. Secondly, my mother thought she had lost her wallet, but after we had checked out the housekeeping staff found it. Zafar called us after we had left the hotel and followed up diligently for the safe return of the contents.

The staff is truly warm and caring and extremely prompt. 

The only issue I have was that food was hugely overpriced. I think they should have a child menu. 

The second concern is that during times of snow (when we visited) we almost missed our flight as our car was stuck in a jam created solely by hotel guests leaving. Given such a large property in such a small town with limited infrastructure the hotel may have to step up the logistic arrangements. Again the staff went out of the way to get our luggage to our car rental that could not get to the hotel due to the massive traffic jam. It was a bit unnerving as all the guests were on the same flight!!!

reviews.author: ROHIT V
reviews.title: Truly Heaven On Earth!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places on earth. Khyber with Himalayan Views was really breath taking, views that you may not also get in Switzerland. The property was well maintained and the staff very courteous. Food was delicious. I was upgraded to the Himalayan View. Thanks a lot for that, otherwise would have missed something unique. Unbelievable, property in the mountain. Double thumbs up!

reviews.author: Omar A
reviews.title: Truly a masterpiece! Out of the world experience
reviews.text:
I would start this review by thanking the Khyber Industries for giving the world a chance to feel and experience the beauty of Kashmir in a truly grand way. We stayed for two nights and it was mesmerising. I would like to add the stay at Khyber, with their highly dedicated staff and five star amenities, was a real delight and an experience of a life time. I would personally like to thank Mr Junaid Ul Hassan and Mr Imtiyaz as they made our stay a real smooth one with memories to cherish for a life time. All staff is really friendly and the food is decent too. 
Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Dr C P Khandelwal
reviews.title: Most beautiful place
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber resort on 22nd March. It was snow every where. Gulmarg was mesmerising. Khyber is the best property in Gulmarg. Very close to Gandolas. Hospitality was excellent. Rooms can easily be rated 7 stars. Views from rooms as well as restaurant was amazing. Food had variety and was excellent. Property is clean, tastefully built and well maintained. There are many thoughtfully created sitting spaces in property,from where you can leisurely emjoy the view. It was really heaven like experience. One day stay was less,will definitely visit this place again.

reviews.author: Bhingri
reviews.title: Exotic!
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is arguably the most beautiful place on earth and Khyber adds luxury to it. The location is good- quite close to the Gondola. The decor is tasteful. Rooms are spacious and clean. (Loved their bedcovers with exquisite kashmiri work on it). Views are breathtaking. The swimming pool, jacuzzi and sauna are fun. Taking a dip in heated swimming pool looking at the snow all around is an experience. The restaurant serves decent food. It is commendable how they run the hotel at such a height. 
However, their service is a mixed package. The reception staff and restaurant staff were helpful and courteous, while some others were very cold and unwelcoming. For some unknown reason, there was no minibar in the room. The bathtub was clean but in a bit rundown condition. The water in the shower was spilling outside even with closed door. Bathroom slippers were missing. 
One big issue is that they do not have any arrangement for the drivers. Most of the people who come here use taxis, hence the concern for driver is very relevant. The outside temperature is pretty low for the driver to spend the night in the vehicle. They have to rush down to Tungmarg - 10-12 km down the hill and come up every time we need their service. They do not want to wait at the hotel because if there is heavy snowfall or any such problem, if the car refuses to start due to cold, they claim that the hotel is very unhelpful and the they get into a fix.
 
So, all in all, its a mix package of goodies with the hotel, but Gulmarg with all its uniqueness and charm makes your trip memorable for sure :)

reviews.author: Moloy Biswas
reviews.title: Great Stay at Khyber
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the best resorts I have stayed so far. The room was quite spacious and had a great view. The decor of the room was very good and was full with required amenities. The room had a very good temperature control system and we were very comfortable inside when it was -2 degrees outside. Buffet Breakfast was well spread and had lot of options. Though the price is quite high, but I feel it is worth the premium class hospitality we received.

reviews.author: debjani g
reviews.title: a piece of heaven on earth
reviews.text: Checked in today and I so don't wanna leave anytime soon... Gorgeous property, friendly staff and amazing food. I had booked a Himalaya view room and the view is to die for. And yes,  love the lot kahwah tea they serve at the lobby lounge. Already planning my next visit.

reviews.author: Madhu Naiker
reviews.title: Excellant place to visit just before winter sets in
reviews.text: The staff were courteous and attentive especially the dinner waiters. Very spacious to wonder around and absorb the scenic atmosphere from outside balcony. Security features very excellent and very safe. A walk away from the Ski lifts "Gondola" make it a very convenient location to stay. Well worth the money.  the hot spa pool is a must especially in Winter.

reviews.author: Sumit K
reviews.title: Enchanting Luxury amidst Exotic Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure to visit this place during end march. I had booked 4nights stay and keen interst was on ski-ing. The property is amazing with good wooden decor, centrelly heated pool and premises. The main part is service which is excellent as every staff greets you each time you pass. My package included dining and breakfast. The dining spread was not much but each time the dishes were different though I expected spme signature Kashmiri dishes like Wazawaan. The breakfast was pretty uniform, nothing much to home about. The hotel is located close to gondola but one needs to climb a steep 700 meters to access it if the visist are frequent so one with small babies be aware of this. From Gondola few cabs can drop you to the hotel at 300 Rs. The pickup and drop is not included and the hotel charges around 4000INR one way which is steep. So its advisable to book a taxi from airport around 2000-2300RS. Sometimes in heavy snow taxi can plough till Tanmarg from where new vehicle, an 4X4 is to be booked around 700 INr but it still is economical. 
The hotel has a central heated pool which gives great view of surrouding snow. The hotel offeres complimentary steam, sauna and jacuzzi services along with gym. The housekeeping and room service is excellent and the quality of towels, linen is upto mark. I had booked the basic premier room which served the purpose if you are family of 2. The views are breathtakig and one can clearly see the sunrise and sunet on adjoining peaks.
A great luxorious experience desrving for a placelike Gulmarg. Khyber hotel is the best with a broaddaylight bewteen it and the other adjoining the area.

reviews.author: IanP-SGP
reviews.title: Great hardware, weak software
reviews.text:
We spent 3 nights at this property in mid March.  Looks were deceiving.  We were delighted by the greeting at the grand, top of the hill entrance and swept into a comfortable lobby with a registration desk and an activities desk.  Perfect!  We wanted to ski, hike wander the area... so after check in, presented ourselves to the Activities desk.  We outlined our hopes enthusiastically.  Response: There are ski shops in the valley.  Gondola tickets? You'll need to queue.  Hiking choices?  Talk to a guide in the village.  And so on.  Disappointed, we weren't going to let the hands off approach cramp our holiday and did indeed manage to find, with much effort, the right stuff.  Why the hotel was unequipped to help was perplexing.

However, as we were now negotiating and settling directly with providers we were running through rupees at an alarming rate.  No problem.  Let's change some US$ or Euros at the desk.  Nope.  Response:  Too much paperwork.  You go to the bank in the village.  Doubly perplexed, we asked to see the manager on duty to understand if this was really the right answer for a hotel with aspirations.  Nope.  Response:  He's too busy.  Leave your room number.  We did.  He never called.

So the conclusion: Great location, brilliant surroundings, incompetent and indifferent staff.

reviews.author: Reema_Kesarkar
reviews.title: A deserving Luxury for Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Visited Khyber for 4nights during end of march. The entire hotel is centrally heated with good wooden decor fitting for a 5 star luxury. The best part is the welcoming staff and service which greet you each time you pass them. Room service is very quick and so is housekeeping. I had taken an Himalayan package which included breakfast and dinner. The dinner spread though limited was new each day although few of Kashmiri signature dishes would be welcomed. Breakfast was almost same but good enough to start the day if you stay here and want to go out for ski-ing , my main purpose. I had booked a premier room which is the most basic yet it was spacious. The higher suites have balcony but for family of 2 with a kid the premier room is good enough. The hotel is located near the gondola but one needs to climb a steep incline to reach it so take that in mind if one commutes each day for ski-ing. Ski equipment can be rented at hotel. The hotel charges around 4000INR for pickup and drop one way to the airport which is quite steep. One can easily get good cars around 2000-2300 from srinagar or Gulmarg so keep that in mind. Most times the vehicles if snow is too much get changed at tanmarg which charge around 700 rs till gulmarg, still a good bargain. I also used the spa facilities. The treatments range from 3500 [massage per 60minutes]. the whole approach is good and is relaxing and one can opt for the spa after a day long ski. The hotel has a heated pool just to relax. Its small so do not entertain much of swimming but gives great view of the surrounding while resting . The hotel also gives complimentary steam, sauna, jacuzzi facilities along with gym. The view from the room are breathtaking and one can see amazing sunrise and sunset on the peaks 
To sum up I would say, excellent staff, excellent service, great place and quite a daylight between Khyber and other similar hotels in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Mohashak
reviews.title: A  beautiful property with amazing views
reviews.text:
We have been travelling all over the world and have stayed in some very good hotel, but this hotel is truly special, the view from our room was amazing with the added bonanza of snowfall during our trip which our kids loved, very courteous and helpful staff, although the check in is a bit complicated. Even though the front office staff try to minimize the hassle. The hotel should keep some OTC medecines as we wanted panadol for my son which was not available , and there was no option as shops close early. But to sum up a great place visit and stay.
Mohammed
Kuwait

reviews.author: Sameer D
reviews.title: Excellent hotel and even better assistance
reviews.text:
We Went to Gulmarg in March 2015 and we stayed at his property which was awesome. The hotel is by far the best property there. The rooms were spacious although we got really lucky with an upgrade to the Himalyan views room the last one available at the property when we were there. The hotel had a heated swimming pool which was awesome given it was cold with snow all around us at that time. The food was good we had opted for the half board which included the breakfast and dinner which works our really well. 

The staff at the hotel were really helpful. the GM Mr. Sujit, the front office head Mr. Jerin and also Ms. Preet. There were many others who helped us make our stay very unforgettable but cant remember all names now. 

The last info I would like to give for all travellers to this place. If you like to have a drink please carry your own as the hotel does not serve. they allow you to drink in their common areas as well so just carry your own and then enjoy the other facilities offered by this great property.

reviews.author: Chaitanya A
reviews.title: Highlight of Kashmir with breathtaking views and decor
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a beautiful landscaped property, with a prime location. The Gondola ride is very nearby from the hotel.

We were particularly impressed by the decor of the hotel which is done in a traditional Kashmiri style. We enjoyed great views from our room as well as from the lobby. The lobby was well done up. Our rooms also were extremely well done up.
This is a must visit in Gulmarg. Would recommend to visit the hotel and have a meal even if you are not staying the night.

However there were few issues where the management must rectify things-
We found overall professionalism lacking. The service overall was average.
The jacuzzi for the women was not working. The pool was not heated and the staff had no clue how to increase the temperature.
We also found maintenance lacking with high amounts of seepage on the walls and non-functional lifts! We hope that Khyber is able to rectify these problems or else, this property might soon deteriorate.

reviews.author: jenabaintheworld
reviews.title: beautiful and crazy expensive
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed this hotel--- stunning interior and exterior with absolutely thrilling views of hte mountains!     we did not stay at the hotel, but we did have lunch there during our time in Gulmarg.    Amazing service and EXCELLENT food.   however, this is one the most expensive place in town... .and there are several other places with better value for money.    also, the people (other guests) staying here were very obvious about their wealth and haughty attitude.... i didn't feel welcome here (although my bank account would qualify me in their eyes).    come here for a drink/meal and the ambiance.

reviews.author: hemantm
reviews.title: Crown of gulmarg
reviews.text: A must stay in gulmarg . Lavish rooms with dazzling views of snow clad mountains literally a handshake away . We stayed in the Himalayan view balcony rooms .Unfortunately the swimming pool was not functioning . The steam rooms are not attended properly and do not even have combs ! The jacuzzi too was not working . But still the location overpowers these deficiencies and if the management bucks up a bit , it would be fantastic

reviews.author: MoinBin
reviews.title: Dazzling Experience
reviews.text: i along with my family stayed at The Khyber in early April, I have no words to describe the expereince @ Khyber,I had come all d way from Dubai and i had apprehensions of d service and hospitality.However i was awe struck during my stay right from the checkin to checkout everything was flawless.The service at the Cloves deserves a special mention. I understand dat their restaurant is small to adjust all their guests however their staff makes sure that they make d dining experience a special one.I would highly rate this hotel to my friends and family,

reviews.author: MahimaG28
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: This hotel is gorgeous , placed in absolute winter wonderland during the colder months in gulmarg. I stayed here in January 2014 and absolutely loved this paradise. Gulmarg was WHITE , all snowed out and beautiful! The hotel sends you transport to pick you up from the Srinagar airport and Khyber is about 2 hours away. Comfortable drive and you arrive at this winter palace , perfectly heated for the chilly weather outside with beautiful kashmiri interiors and not too forget the beautiful photographs of kashmir displayed throughout the hotel. The rooms are comfortable and have windows to enjoy the views of the outside. The hotel is equipped with a spa , a heated pool and a gym all functional. I got a massage at the spa during my visit which was very relaxing. The pool is placed at amongst huge windows with views of the outside , something which caught my eye being a nature fanatic. We took ski lessons on both days which is about 5 minutes by car from the hotel. The service of the hotel is great , the staff is humble and very very helpful. There is one restaurant with a buffet dinner , with really good food. There is a cafe , where you can ask for authentic kashmiri kava (kashmiri tea) and there is also a lounge serving sheesha! My only drawback would be that the hotel doesn't serve alcohol to be sure to carry some with you before getting here as you are allowed to have it and they will serve you which is great. All in all absolute paradise , a great place to vacay with your family or loved ones. Gulmarg is beautiful during the winter months , absolute winter wonderland!

reviews.author: Aarti Sethi
reviews.title: It's Average
reviews.text:
We were super excited about this trip-we were going back to Kashmir after almost 30 years! And we had heard good things about this new hotel-the Khyber.

It was nice. Like any hotel anywhere in the world. A nice spa, central heating, Heated swimming pool et al. 

The service as far as the waiters were concerned was great. But the management really needs to have a long, hard look at itself. There is a serious attitude problem at the Khyber and we fail to understand why. With the exception of Mr Amir at the coffee shop (he was very good) we could not understand why all the guys in the black suits were surly, unhelpful and just-plain stuck up. In the hospitality industry, it is baffling….because our stay is not free, we are paying for our rooms.

Having said that, the view from our balcony was spectacular. It was snowing when we were there and we loved every moment of that. The view from the coffee shop was also great (there is no other restaurant) and we really liked that, but be prepared for average food, and do not talk to any manager. 

At the 'Cigar Room' were told that we can smoke cigars but cigarettes are not allowed. Really?

There's a nice cappuccino machine at their pastry shop but they will not serve you the coffee at breakfast unless you go to the pastry shop and pay for it. (as we were told rudely by someone called Rajiv).

On the other hand, the hotel is located very well near the Gondolas, and is a very short walk from there. 

Please arrange taxis for anywhere before hand, because the hotel will not help you with this.

reviews.author: Keya1976
reviews.title: Paradise  on Earth
reviews.text: Gulmarg itself is the paradise on Earth,and Khyber is the paradise's garden from where you can enjoy the beauty of paradise.The helpful nature of the staffs,the cleanliness of the hotel is the additional fragrance of the garden.My right hand got fractured by slipping on the snow and its a common phenomena in any such places but the prompt fast aided by the house physician of the hotel is something which I will remember for ever.The house physician was too sincere that he made it a point to check my hand every 12hrs .I stayed at number of 05star hotels in different places of World but the warmth of careness I received from this hotel is unmatchable  .I hope they maintain this standard of them .

reviews.author: TheBot77
reviews.title: Nice Hotel; Very poor service

reviews.author: Avinash C
reviews.title: mountain palace
reviews.text:
stayed here during my kashmir trip..... and i was fortunate to witness gulmarg in its full snowy beauty ... we stayed in the balcony room .... and the view is all snow ( stay dates 22 to 24th april 2014).... hotel .... has wonderful staff very soft and and quick ..... the heated pool/  gym ... are in immaculate condition ..... try to take all meals plan as there is hardly any hotels nearby .... its  not a bad idea for a weekend plan from mumbai as you can reach the hotel within 3 hours of landing at the srinagar airport

if its gulmarg it has to be Khyber

reviews.author: Surojit Ray
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text: This is the best staying option in Gulmarg without any doubt. Possibly, the best staying option in Kashmir. I stayed there with my family in April 2014. Everything in this hotel is flawless (the view, the rooms, the service, the food, the staff, the hospitality and the location). This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in (this is after having stayed in several five star hotels in India and overseas). The view from some of the rooms can take you to dreamland. It is hard to express in words how beautiful the views are! Gulmarg in itself is beautiful and this hotel is a jewel in the crown of Gulmarg. Hats off to the management for maintaining this property so brilliantly. Every person going to Gulmarg and having the capacity to afford this hotel should go for it blindly. It is a once in lifetime experience without doubt....Special mention for the food,,,it was awesome....

reviews.author: madhurtodi
reviews.title: Amazing ! Super Duper !
reviews.text:
Anything that i write will not be enough for this property. The promoters have not spared any money in making this truly a world class property right in the middle of such scenic environment. 
The rooms are spacious and large, the bath rooms are big and spacious ! The huge tub in the bathroom has a window right beside it and it was great fun seeing snowfall outside while soaking in the hot tub !!!
They have an indoor / heated swimming pool and a separate one for children, this was a very good feature about this property and the kids loved splashing around while it was snowing and raining outside !
We had gone there to celebrate my moms 60th birthday and the hotel gave a complimentary cake for the same. They even decorated one of the room balcony with flower petals and candles and we cut the cake birthday cake there !
Only negative was the service during the breakfast buffet. The area is not very huge and they are not properly staffed to handle 100% occupancy ! We saw many guests complain of poor service and we also faced the same. My wife had asked for coffee at 10.10am and then had to remind the waiter at 10.40am that she had yet not got hot coffee. The waiter was so rude that he pointed to his watch and said that he could not serve it to her now as the breakfast time was over at 10.30 !!! We were appalled and called the manager in charge. This is the first time in my life i have heard such an rude tone and answer from any staff in any 4-5 star property anywhere in the world !
Overall, this is the best property in gulmarg (and maybe in J&K). Even though it is highly priced (23k INR per night incl only bfast) I would recommend people to stay here.

reviews.author: Murari T
reviews.title: excellent property
reviews.text:
We had wanted to book this property but it was heavily sold out and finally our travel agent was able to manage some premium rooms with balcony for us. The rooms were great with v good view. The balcony was good place to sit and relax although it was snowing most of the time.
The rooms, corridors and reception area were well heated and one need have to go out to reach spa/pool or your rooms. The IGLOO (playing area ) was great fun.
The check in process was completed but person assigned to escort us to rooms was non courteous and more busy chatting with others until finally, after 15 mins, Ms Shivangi from front desk came to our help. She was really helpful through out our stay.
The Gulmarg was better then any hill station (including swiss) and with snow it was icing.
I would recommend this hotel to any other in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: ShyamReddy
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg. Period.
reviews.text: Had a very pleasant stay with stunning views from the room. Service is outstanding and the food is very good. There is no other five star property in Gulmarg. Of special mention are service personnel in the coffee shop and the cigar room. They have a very good collection of cigars as well.

reviews.author: JohnnyChef
reviews.title: Fogettable
reviews.text: I had been looking forward to skiing in Gulmarg for many years. I was disappointed to find out that the Five Star Khyber Hotel was full so I looked online and found this four star hotel. From the moment I arrived it was obvious it was no four star hotel. I was shown to my room and the carpet was rotten, black almost. At night time the power would go off and it was freezing, the internet and television never worked. The breakfast was inedible and I am a chef who came to India to do a months cooking course in Delhi. The service was rude and unfriendly whenever I complained which was obviously often. The windows were covered in plastic so the view was restricted. Look don't call yourself a four star hotel if you are clearly not. I have stayed in better one star hotels. I will be back and I will book in advance and stay at the Khyber

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Beautiful Gulmarg, Good Hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is a well respected property in the Gulmarg region. Evident from a half raised eyebrow from most locals whom you mention it to within the city. A group of us checked in for the weekend. Here are the good and bad, good first:

The Good:
wonderful property, spread out, adequately heated so don't need thick layering inside the hotel. Food across the various cuisines offered is excellent. The menu is quite extensive and above expectation for a hotel in the hills with limited access to raw material and talent. 
The guards at the premises are excellent and helpful - they take initiative - helped me carry my 3 year old child over a steep incline on their own. 
The spa and the pool (which i didnt get to use - did not have swimming gear and they had run out of mens gear for sale) is excellent - the biggest regret I have is not being able to get into the pool. 

The bad:
Housekeeping had to be reminded at 1030am and then again at 230pm to clean room. Bathtub when filled with water had hair floating in it. The upkeep of the rooms is mediocre. The shower head flew out when the water was switched on, I left it on the floor for the housekeeping to see and fix but happened again the next day. Carry your own umbrella - room does not have any and porch had run out. The walls are thin - and you can hear everything from the corridor outside to the floor upstairs - footsteps, baby crying, people laughing - making it difficult to sleep at night. The uncomfortable mattress does not help either. Everything is expensive, I guess because they are the only hotel in this category in gulmarg. There was a electricity fluctuation issue through our stay - was told the hotel transformer had been acting up that week. Power goes frequently and you are in pitch dark from 10 seconds to a few minutes so be prepared. We were 2 adults + 1 toddler in room, I asked for an extra bed was charged another 3,000 Rs.  and the housekeeping guys came and opened the sofa to make it an extra bed - felt robbed. There is a kids play room - with basic stuff - better than not having one at all.

The biggest experience make or break for me is the first point of contact at any check in i.e. reception - here the hotel failed miserably. The check in person feigned ignorance on my credit card companies tie up for an upgrade even though I had it in writing. I understand it is subject to availability but she was of the belief that there is no entitlement only. Was kind of rude until her senior stepped in and took over. 

On the whole a good weekend family property, excellent food, go with low expectations on service and a heavy wallet.

reviews.author: ShantiTravel
reviews.title: Prefect hotel in winter holidays & summer
reviews.text:
Staying at Khyber hotel has been a great experience. The staff is great and the management too.  Spa is awesome, the pool is great with crazy view. Rooms are big. The food was  good even if we slept and there for 3 nights. 
For Skying, there are places to keep our skys. Trasnfers have been a bit complicated but finally it worked.

reviews.author: Inna T
reviews.title: Incredible!
reviews.text: It was my first visit to Gulmarg for free-ride. The hotel is a real 5 star! Nice personnel ready to provide any assistance you need. The food is very delicious. The view of the room is perfect! SPA complex is very nice and useful after riding. Especial thanks to the General Manager Mr. Aditia! We felt like home. The only disappointment that there is no alcohol in the restaurant but you can bring it with you.

reviews.author: RajeshDube
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week...unforgettable experience ....excellent location...heavenly surroundings....excellent service....the property is one of the best I have seen so far. This is a true experience of Heaven on Earth !! The resort is surrounded by green forests and conveniently located near the Gondola ride. The resort has a beautiful swimming pool and spa. The food served here is mouth watering and true reflection of Kashmiri cuisine . Even during snow fall the temperature inside the resort is conveniently maintained for comfort. The resort has sufficient number of rooms to hold business conferences and also big corporate gatherings. The staff is very polite and ready to offer their services.
 The resort architecture and design is very tastefully done and it is said that it took seven years for the construction to take place and complete.location wise I feel this is the best located property in Gulmarg. I recommend to visit this place after snowfall as this is the best time to. Enjoy the surroundings. Go there with family or friends, you are bound to enjoy every moment spent there. Evening time with Kahwah is always one looks forward to !!

reviews.author: Rohit912
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: The best place to stay in Gulmarg. Cant ask for anything more. Special thanks to Mir Zafar Malik for his exceptional service and hospitality. Will recommend everybody who wants to experience luxury. The view from the rooms are breathtaking.

reviews.author: Kumar R
reviews.title: The only 5-Star around at Gulmarg, placed strategically close to the Gondola Ride.
reviews.text:
At the last half hour of our trip towards Gulmarg, amongst the twist and turns driving up the beautiful scenic pathway ever seen with abundance of snow, we finally reached Khyber Resort (5 Star) at around 6 pm. As we exit out of the car, it starts to Snow & my kid is already excited.

The room given to us is a Premier room, the view outside our room was breathtaking. Since our room was at the ground level, we could see snow everywhere. Must be 3-4 feet of snow. My son & myself were all gung-ho to get out, but we could not, as there was a delay on sending our luggage to our room.

By the time the luggage came in, it was already snowing heavily. But my son just wanted to get out there & njoy every bit of it. The temp outside was 4 degree.

The room was excellent with comfortable beat, central heating, wardrobe, safe, bathtub with separate section for shower & toilet.. We stayed here for one night only. It is good to stay and get acclimatised before you head up for the Gondola Ride.  Only problem was the lift was not working. The elders here has a torrid time to climb up and down .

The Buffet dinner & breakfast is simply awesome.. The service was also excellent.

The walk towards the Gondola ride from the hotel was only 5 mins downhill. At the ticket window, we were disappointed to know that Phase II (Rs. 800 per head) was shut because of heavy snow & mist. Nevertheless, we bought the tickets for Phase I (Rs. 600 per head)

The 12 min ropeway ride was just awesome with beautiful pine trees covered with snow that could be seen below. As we reached the top, visibility was near zero due to the heavy snowfall again. Once we reached outside, it was breathtakingly beautiful with soft snow covered layers everywhere.. Gulmarg is famous for it’s soft velvet snow that falls here.. 

Post clicking some snaps, myself & my sons tried our hands in skiing (Rs. 900 per head unlimited time post a good bargain). I found skiing extremely hard, but my son took it as a duck to the water. After a few rounds, I was able to get a hang of it and ride it easily. My son continued for another half hour. Later the crowd started to swell in and there was hardly any place to ski around. 

Would definitely suggest to stay at this hotel. Though prices higher, it well worth every dime.

reviews.author: Anil J
reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: The Khyber is an awesome hotel in one of the most pictureque places in India. I stayed with my family in March, and the experience was wonderful. The staff are extremely cordial, the facilities excellent (TV, swimming pool etc.), and it is very near the Gulmarg Gondola. Also, the room tariff is very reasonable considering the quality of this property. The only drawback, if i may say so, is the uphill trek from the gondola to the hotel, which can be very difficult if there is ice on the road. Overall, a great experience. A special thanks to Shakeel for all his help during our stay

reviews.author: Saurabh_Fadia
reviews.title: Quite a good hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel is located very near the key attraction of Gulmarg - The Gondola. The resort is well designed & has quite good facilities. The food range is not very wide but certainly tasty.
I was there for a conference & hence the number of people were too many (Over 70 - 80) & hence the hotel seemed understaffed. But if you were to visit with a smaller group of even 15  people i think they will be able to provide good service since the staff seemed motivated to serve.
The elevators were present but non functional causing us to be breathless climbing 4 floors in freezing cold everyday

reviews.author: Everywhere Escapes
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text:
Visited last year. Nothing short of spectacular. The location is breathtaking!The views through the property rooms are unbelievable! A must visit if in Gulmarg! Certainly number 1 hotel in Gulmarg at this point. 

The restaurant has a reasonable selection. The service is quite impressive.  THe rooms are nicely done, and are at par with any 5 star hotel in the world.

The proximity to the Gondola is a plus.
The only minus is the overpriced rooms.

reviews.author: Nirajp
reviews.title: Luxury, Great views - Service could be better
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter this property, one can figure that this is a luxury hotel. Beautiful wooden interiors with beautiful furnishings. The lobby has a coffee shop overlooking the beautiful nature outside. When we reached, it just started snowing and the view was awesome.

Check-in : Check-in process was very quick. No issues

Room - The room is spacious, with almost all rooms having great views. The room has a large LED TV with a separate DTH connection. First hotel in India where I have experienced HD TV and HD DTH connection. There is a clear intent to maintain the luxury quotient. The bathroom is spacious with a separate tub and shower area with top-end bath fittings. The bathroom and room are separated by a half glass panel (covered by blinds) which might not be something which all families would be ok with. A mini-bar and tea / coffee maker.  Overall a good comfortable room

Location :- A 5 mins walk (hike) from the Gondola, the location is perfect. Close but yet not in the midst of crowd.

Food :- The taste was average, including local Kashmiri cuisine. They definitely look at this aspect. The breakfast spread was also not great, though they do offer a complete spread of Indian + Continental breakfast. Room service is very very expensive.

Acitivities :- They have a large game room with XBOX installed. Also a small theater with a DVD collection. There is an indoor heated pool as well.

Service :- This was the disappointing part. The staff doesn't seem to be professionally trained for service at this kind of a luxury hotel. The service was nowhere near 5-star standard. The communication (or lack or it), promptness left lot to be desired. There is lot of scope for improvement in this area. We got a glimpse of this during the check-out process. I had to dial atleast 3-4 times before someone picked up at the reception. Even after this no one turned up to pick the luggage. Finally I had to personally go and request at the reception.

reviews.author: Sajeev S
reviews.title: Good location, bad staff
reviews.text: This is in a great location with stunning views and very close to the gondola. The room service is horrible. It takes ages for staff response. We had dinner in our room on both days we stayed there and after dinner we asked to remove the plates but were never taken despite twice reminding them and finally had to leave it outside our room. The same happened on the next day also and in the morning at 8 AM we asked for a bottle of water to prepare tea. This bottle never came until we checked out at 9.45 !!! so much for room service.

reviews.author: Viineet K
reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel with breath taking views
reviews.text:
Nice and spacious rooms with breath taking view from the room, as soon as you open your eyes in the morning you see lots n lots of snow in winters and lush green gardens in summers and rainy seasons.. In winters if you are lucky enough to be there to witness the snowfall, it's a total bliss!! 

For Skiers GULMARG, Kashmir is paradise and specially for Americans, Europeans, Japanese, Australians and other first world countrymen it is not only a fantastic experience but ''dirt cheap''. Khyber is just next to the Gondola point from where you can go on the top of the snow peaks and for Skiers a 'IDEAL LOCATION'!!

Food is not that great, but good, I would rate it as 6 out of 10.. Service is quite good and the Staff is very friendly & caring..!! Though, the property is just a year old and hope they can maintain the standards for years to come..!! 

All the best to The Khyber team!!

reviews.author: Sanjeev A
reviews.title: Sanjeev aggarwal
reviews.text: We were visit hotel at 31 march for 2 nights resort is excellent,good location just 5 mnts walk to gondola cable,restaurant & food is good but there is nothing to do in the resort if u are single family u wll be bored no fun zone,no dvdplayer in the rooms,no games like ,chess,cards,ludo,there heated pool was not working children's get bored only option see tv at room.

reviews.author: Sekhar1966
reviews.title: Super Resort
reviews.text:
I just stayed for 3 nights at the Khyber Himalayan Resort last week. I was traveling with my family and friends and we had booked 8 rooms & cottages.
The resort property is simply fantastic. The rooms are large and very comfortable. The bathrooms are spacious and have all modern amenities. The resort's close proximity to the Gondola is a huge benefit.
We had taken a 3 night package which included breakfast, dinner, free Gondola ride to phase 1 for 2 persons and a free pick up and drop to Srinagar.
The package rates are very attractive.
The resort has great facilities such as a heated swimming pool, spa, a private theater room, restaurants, hookah bar etc.Or stay was very comfortable and will definitely go back again.
The only negative that I can think of is that the room service menu is very highly priced. It is more expensive than a super deluxe 5 star hotel.

reviews.author: Tall Mama K
reviews.title: Beauty and luxury
reviews.text: We spent one night in this beautiful and luxurious resort, and were impressed by it's perfect location to start a trek or take the highest gondola in the world. It's decor is beautifully Kashmiri, the rooms are spacious and comfortable. Service was impeccable. There was unfortunately a problem with the hot water at the swimming pool which we as a result did not use , with regret as it has amazing views from it. Instead we enjoyed a great treatment at the spa. We highly recommend this hotel and would gladly come back.

reviews.author: armeetsingh
reviews.title: Amazing hotel with excellent service
reviews.text:
We arrived at the khyber at a time when the entire state of J&K was severely impacted by heavy snowfall. However there is was no let down in the services of the hotel, the staff, the food, every thing was upto the mark. 

The staff of the hotel really goes the extra mile interms of giving you the best of services, i would specially like to thank "Shivangi" for making our stay so memorable.

reviews.author: Vaibhav K
reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text:
As we booked this hotel based the reviews posted here, we had many expectations and its very true that it stands to THE BEST. We were more than delighted when we were received at hotel.
The overall treatment with welcome was very personalized. The food was the best.
The view from our room was most beautiful and tranquil. It's the most luxurious. Enjoyed the snowfall. As we say " Kashmir is paradise on the Earth", this hotel provides the best way to enjoy this PARADISE. We take this opportunity to thanks the management of this hotel for providing such a best, comfortable property to us, the travelers. We will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: AJAYNAGPAL
reviews.title: Fantastic stay and Divine experience....
reviews.text: The final journey of Kashmir Trip was a mesmerising stay at Khyber, Gulmarg. The resort is ideally situated next to Gondola. Commendable are the efforts of the management and staff to provide luxury of a 7 star at such a height in cold weather conditions. The place has very comfortable rooms and the bathrooms are lavish. Food is good. If you are a vegetarian it is advisable to go for a-la carte and choose food to suit your taste buds rather than lavish buffet which cater to taste buds of non-vegetarians. A special mention here is in respect of indoor activity for kids and the indoor temperature controlled pool. Stay was indeed Fantastic and a Divine experience......

reviews.author: Aditya M
reviews.title: Khyber Resort - Beautiful Property and Best Option to Stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber in April 2013.....The one word which describes our stay is " Amazing" . All aspects are taken care of for a luxurious stay..... Once the other infrastructure like swimming pool, spa and children activity center becomes operational it will be the one of THE place in Kashmir Valley. Very well done up interiors and great service. Some teething issues are there but 'm sure that these aspects will be taken care of.

reviews.author: Vinay S
reviews.title: World Class facilities but still some rough edges
reviews.text:
Had prebooked this hotel a long time before the actual check in date. Started from Sonamarg early in the day, went directly to the Gondola and after a tiring day went to the resort looking for a hot bath. However found that the reservation desk had messed up my reservation and inspite of having paid the full amount in advance there was no room for me. The matter was sorted out after an irritatingly long wait and I was taken to my room.
The room is magnificient & luxurious by any standard. Decorated in the most elegant and aesthetic way, the balcony rooms were delightful. Everything, the decor, the presentation, the luxury, the service, the food was top notch. But inspite of all of this I did not carry back fond memories. The reasons are as under:
1) There was an argument at the entrance of Gulmarg with the people manning the barrier. Outside cars are not allowed inside Gulmarg unless the traveller has a booking for night stay. I was told that the mail of the reservation desk was not clear regarding booking.
2) As already mentioned my reservation was all messed up. I had modified my reservation dates and had obtained a confirmation from the hotel but it seemed that the changes were not made at the hotel database. Luckily I had carried print out of the entire emails and so was able to make my point. However precious time was lost in this.
3) At the time of check out I was presented with the bill with tarriff different from the promised one. Moreover my advance was also not being given credit. This again caused long delay and was sorted out after going through my emails. Surprisingly the hotel has till date not been able to trace out the payment inspite of me having providing the snap shot of all slips and bank account. This was however was not a good experience.
So once the sharp edges are softened Im sure it would be wonderful to go back.

reviews.author: NirajBVashi
reviews.title: Best Luxury Hotel in Kashmir
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort (spa is still coming up) is arguably the most luxurious hotel in Kashmir. Everything there is built for the luxury traveller (Spa, heated Swimming pool will be ready soon). Considering that Kashmir dont have many brand new hotels, Khyber is simply multiple notches above everyone else. Considering its started recently (Dec 2012), few things still need refinements (e.g. Electric blankets are missing, Wi-Fi is chargeable and Buffet meals are too expensive), its still is an experience that will leave lasting impression. It has closest Himalayan views, nice away from market and close to gondola location and also the only hotel in Gulmarg that offers complimentary transfers to Gondola and market.

reviews.author: Marryam R
reviews.title: In the lap of the gods
reviews.text: It's a completely contemporary building, but made of wood and stone, with a few elements of local Kashmiri architecture. There's nothing like it in the rest of the Kashmir Valley, and it is clear that it has been made with passion and inspiration. There is a wealth of handicrafts all over the building, but taken together, they don't give the look of a junky handicraft store. The food is superb, whether it is the Irish Angus steak (I asked for mine blue and it came perfectly done) to the Kashmiri banquet dishes; from the Illy coffee in the lounge to the ginger cookies that are served with kahwa, fragrant with saffron. This is easily the best resort/hotel/guest house in the Kashmir Valley. And further even. The warmth of the mainly Kashmiri staff and their professionalism will have me going back for more!

reviews.author: Horizonseaker
reviews.title: Excellent property, fantastic location.
reviews.text: Khyber is located close to the Gondola at Gulmarg.  This is a tastefully decorated five star property.  The rooms offer great views, especially the ones facing the Aparwath mountain.  The beds very comfortable.  the rooms are spacious and clean.  The washrooms have a small walkin wardrobe and a nice tub.  The spa is yet to commence operations.  Liquor is currently not available at the property.  The restaurants offer very good food of different cuisines.  There's lot of snow in the backyard for kids to play during winters.  Each room has a balcony with a sit out, it's a present experience to sit on these in he mornings / evenings.  The hotel is new, they are still evolving the finer aspects of managing this magnificent property.  Gondola is at a walking distance, otherwise It's desirable to have your own transport to commute.
